summary: FE/BE Column sorting not working - Advisor analysis
reported_issue: Only the first four columns (date, invoice number, customer, advisor) of the Advisor Analysis report should be sortable with a visual sort indicator; the remaining columns must not be sortable.
expected_after_fix: First 4 columns sortable ascending/descending with arrow indicator; columns beyond the first four not sortable.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened Reports and clicked Advisor Analysis (/reports/service-advisor-analysis)
Enumerated all table header cells and checked for sort arrow indicators
Captured first-column order, clicked the Date header, re-captured order
actual_now: Columns 0-3 (Date, Invoice, Customer, Advisor) each display an arrow_drop_up sort indicator; columns 4-17 (Days Open, Lines, Hrs Worked ... Subtotal) have no sort arrow. Clicking the Date header re-sorted the data (from Jul 03 2026 descending to Jul 01 2026 ascending).
notes: Exactly matches requirement: only the first four columns are sortable.
